title: Research: F17 block-scale scan bill at the exact entry width (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

One unpaid term from [#3374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3374), under priority revision 6, card `joint-query-controller`. That pull request already binds the F17 pair kernel and the 464-field bit count at `λ=1`, `f=64`, `e=0`, `β=64`, `W=532`. This package prices the common block-scale scan at those same parameters.

The incorporated scan polynomial, with `w=W-3=529` and `p=k=137`, gives one owner-local line `4232 D + 2415` gates. Across the 336-line decoder the scan subtotal is at most

```text
1421952 N D + 811440 N
```

gate evaluations. The published `W=456` control stays `1217664 N D + 666624 N`.

**Partial bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Scalar ADDs, wrappers, maps, addressing, movement and cleanup remain unpaid. The pair-kernel and field-bit coefficients are not recomputed.

## Result

Package: `research/qq16-f17-scan-bill/`.
Tip: `7e48a92a3f6e8dba9b4b7450251c3bbe98e7d484`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/qq16-f17-scan-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/qq16-f17-scan-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/qq16-f17-scan-bill/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/qq16-f17-scan-bill/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-f17-scan-bill
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_QQ16_F17_SCAN_BILL W=532 scan=1421952*N*D+811440*N control=1217664*N*D+666624*N no_new_kappa
PASS_QQ16_F17_SCAN_BILL_INDEPENDENT W=532 scan=1421952*N*D+811440*N control=1217664*N*D+666624*N no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-f17-scan-bill outcome=partial
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

`research/qq16-block-scale-scan` evaluates the same polynomial at `W=456`. `W=532` is the published example in `research/qq16-producer-entry-contract`. This package does not reopen [#3374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3374), [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349), the deferred V45 histogram, or the merged readout series through [#2883](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2883).

Credit Arham Tahir for the block-scale scan polynomial and Nick Petalas for the entry contract. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
